user_report: File added on phone under Download not shown on Mac
source_findings: AFT GetChildren returns _files cache indefinitely once populated.
ReadDir caches encoded directory entries independently.
PollEvent parses/logs notifications but does not invalidate FUSE directory caches.
boundary: Guest FUSE already misses the file; not solely Finder/macOS NFS cache. Same-session raw MTP re-enumeration has not been observed, so phone MTP indexing remains a separate possible contributor.
